lines.text: The psalm calls for a new song because His right hand and holy arm gained Him the victory.
The LORD remembered His love and faithfulness to the house of Jacob, and all the earth saw His salvation.
All the earth is called to make a joyful noise to the LORD, with the lyre and the harp.
The psalm calls for trumpets and cymbals, with shouts of joy before the LORD, the King.
The rivers are called to clap and the mountains to sing, for the LORD comes to judge the earth.
